judge.rationale: The candidate accurately implements the core logic: wrapping non-Error rejections in an `Error` with `cause` set to the original value, passing existing `Error` instances through unchanged, and rethrowing the original value to the caller. It fulfills all acceptance criteria, including updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. Minor deductions apply because the candidate leaves behind `.lore/dod.md` and an unrelated change in `scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs`, splits tests and a 3-line helper into three new files instead of keeping them in `chatOrchestrator.ts` / `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and uses `String(rejection)` (which produces `[object Object]` for plain objects despite claiming a 'readable message') whereas the reference uses `JSON.stringify` with a `String()` fallback. Note also that the acceptance test for `onError` does not assert `error.cause` at the orchestrator boundary (only in the unit test for `rejectionError`), though the wiring makes it hold in practice.
